read_gguf_file: run the reader.py script to parse and display key-value pairs and tensor metadata from a GGUF model file
read_gguf_tensors: read a GGUF file and list all tensors with their shapes, element counts, and quantization types
read_gguf_metadata: read a GGUF file and extract all key-value metadata fields in a columnized format
review_reader_script: review the reader.py CLI script that parses GGUF files and prints model metadata and tensor info
summarize_gguf_file: summarize a GGUF file by listing its key-value pairs and tensor dimensions with quantization types
